title: Wings live: Forum, Inglewood | 1976
content:
Wings performed at the Forum in Inglewood, California, USA, on 22 June 1976.

It was the 57th night of the 65-date Wings Over The World Tour, which ran from September 1975 to October 1976, and the second of three consecutive nights in Inglewood.

The McCartneys met Magneto co-creator Jack Kirby backstage, and gave him front row seats for the show. In exchange Kirby gave them an 11×17″ drawing he did of the band fleeing Magneto’s clutches. Wings’ song ‘Magneto And Titanium Man’ appeared on their fourth album Venus And Mars.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Jimmy McCulloch on guitar and vocals; and Joe English on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.

Paul McCartney returned to the Forum on 23, 24, 27, 28, and 29 November 1989.
